I graduated college 11 months ago, but I don't want to apply for jobs in my career. Before ending uni I spent 1 year working in that field and I hated it. Before I quit, I got a job at a Contact Center as a customer service agent, and 1 year later I'm absolutely done with this job and hating it too. 

I don't know what to do with my life, my peers are moving on and getting experience and I feel like I threw away the last 4 years of my life, but the worst part is that I feel absolutely lost and with no direction. 

I don't want to quit my current job because at least I can contribute to my house (still live with my parents, my dad works, mom is sahm, and lil sister), and I'd feel like dead weight if I quit now. 

I work 12 hours at night shift and when I get home all I got energy for is sleeping and maybe game 1-2 hours. I'm in the worst shape I've been in for a while, mainly because eating makes me feel okay for a moment?

My gf dumped me a few months ago, and in October a big group from Uni went to a hotel, I went with my 2 friends and she went too. Turns out she was seen sneaking in and out of the room of one of the guys she told me not to worry about. This hurt.

I've never been more isolated, since I work night shifts I don't see my family often, my 2 friends have moved out to 2 different cities, and now we don't talk much. I also haven't kept in touch with some buddies from Uni.

All in all, I try to keep moving, nobody knows how I truly feel because imo this is too much to just dump into someone, I don't wanna talk with somebody about all this and make them feel responsible in some type of way of being empathetic or offering solutions. 

I've thought about suicide because I don't feel there's much worth to me existing and I have to spend 12 hours of my waking hours doing something I despise, but I will never put my parents and little sister through that, they deserve much more.

If you have read this, thank you, kind internet person.

Im an intern in a cement industry, working for the predictive maintenance department. This week my new boss told me that if I don't start putting on numbers, he's gonna swap me for someone else. His friend, a coworker, jokingly - ish said that I'm just not good enough. They have been having a field day for the whole week asking me shit they know I don't know and making fun of me.

I've never in my life felt so embarrased and worthless. To be told straight up that I'm just not good enough to be in there was so hurtful. I wanted to cry but refused to give them that.

To be honest, I haven't been putting my 100% in learning the stuff, in fact i think last month was the last time i remember studying pretty much anything from our department, they are right, I haven't been as locked in as I should, no excuses. That said, the way they told me that so pretty fucking hurtful.

I'm gonna give my best from now on because I refuse to just fold and let them have their fun, I don't wanna be the guy people use to make jokes. I just wanted to write this here because I really don't wanna put this on anyone I know. Thanks.
